risk_note: RV2 (ledger + payout port). Console close of a reconciliation difference (CT-24w closeAdminReconDiff; 08 BR-FUND-19 「差错单关闭时解除冻结记录」, BR-WDR-05; 04 §3.2, §11.2 fund.recon; admin-recon.md §4 / §5; orchestrator ruling 2026-10-29 20:00: no step-up, hold source matched exactly as the existing writer's recon_diff:<id>). Single writers kept: ledger alone changes recon_diffs (row FOR UPDATE, status CAS from open / processing for the app's own R1–R3 rows to closed with handler_id, closed_at from the injected Clock, resolution.reason kept with the existing keys); payout alone changes withdraw_holds — new releaseWithdrawHoldsBySource (source_ref exactly recon_diff:<id>, users rows locked in user_id order and re-read under the lock, sharing releaseLocked with release, one withdraw_hold.release audit per hold, released ones skipped); ledger does not import payout, app.module injects payout's port into LedgerAdminModule. Lock order: difference row, then users rows — the same order as payout's recon-job (register difference, then add holds). Audit recon_diff_close (target the difference, before / after status and released_hold_count, no personal data); Idempotency-Key replay returns the first answer; any failure rolls the whole close back. No amounts change. Test-machine full verification verify/2 exit 0 (b9f9bf61, PROP_RUNS=2000, after rebasing onto main with CT-24w #1778); verify/1 had failed only on CT-24w's catalog.test line, which #1778 fixed.
